description: This file defines the SystemCheckAPI class within a specific namespace. The class extends another API class to handle system check requests, particularly ensuring data encryption permissions are verifiable. It overrides the handleGet method to add a check for writable permissions on a crypto keys directory when data encryption is enabled.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: API controller for performing system checks during installation, extending existing system check capabilities and adding specific checks related to data encryption permissions.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Overrides the parent handleGet method to include an additional check for crypto key directory writable permissions if data encryption is enabled.
